title: A quota sample has a composition
hook: Two stated cases: explore the group weights behind a toy electoral estimate.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the group weights behind a toy electoral estimate affects the stated comparison
